judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across all reporting rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` using an `accumulateUsage` helper identical in logic to the reference. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), handling omitted round usage, updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and leaving the existing single-round test unedited. To satisfy the criterion that 'The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous' and the tech notes mention of `src/types/ai.ts`, the candidate introduces and exports a `TurnTotalUsage = UsageMetadata` type alias in addition to renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`, whereas the reference only renamed the parameter. Aside from adding a separate acceptance test file and leaving behind `.lore/dod.md`, the implementation touches the exact same seams and documentation files as the reference.
